Unassuming gem of a cafe
Dec 2018 • Couples
Lost in a city of eateries we thankfully found Fresh Cafe. Family owned, with own 2-star hotel upstairs, this cafe (right opposite The Grand hotel) has inside and outside tables. There’s an extensive menu to choose from. We went for a plate of morning glory with garlic, freshly made rice paper rolls, chicken pho and spring roll vermicelli salad. All delicious! Great food, and teemed with the friendly service by owner and staff, it’s easy to see why this clean establishment is busy with locals and foreigners alike.

Great value and service
Feb 2018 • Couples
Found this cafe after a failed New Year attempt to eat at Hum. This is such a nice place. The food is really good and so reasonable. What is great is the opportunity to people watch off the Main Street whilst enjoying drinks that are incredible value compared to the surrounding area. I chose the local Dalat wine which was so good and only 190 vnd a bottle 😄very much recommended. The staff are also really polite and the service is very good. Go if you like local and non fancy.

Very good
Feb 2018 • Couples
I wish we had have found this place the first night. We travelled around trying to find good food places and stumbled into several tourist traps, but this place was hiding close to us the whole time.

I had the spring roll vermicelli and tomato sardines (Yes, I'm trying to grow a food baby) and my girlfriend had some spicy pho.

Both of my dishes were pretty good, but the spring rolls were really really nice. The Vietnamese red wine I had was not great either, but all in all I think the food was the best I had in Ho Chi Minh for the price.

My girlfriend's dish was nice, but she did complain the meat was a bit fatty and wasn't spicy enough for her. But she is Chinese, so maybe it will burn your mouth out.

Great place with the best spring rolls
Jun 2017 • Friends
We visited this little cafe last year while staying opposite at the Grand Hotel Saigon and found the owners to be charming delightful people.
We returned to HCMCity for a few days and ate mostly at their cafe. They have the best seafood spring rolls, home made (unlike a lot of the spring rolls in HCMC, which seem to come from the same source, and are small and dried up).
The menu is colourful with pictures and very well priced.

They have great staff that make very good frozen margueritas. We also found out that the owner has just opened a beauty school, and while we were there had some work done, me having a disasterous eyebrow tattoo fixed up.

Great Local Food at this gem of a restaurant
Nov 2016 • Friends
Staying in the hotel opposite, and, as with our last visit to Saigon, this restaurant became a place of frequent visits for drinks, morning, afternoon and nightly snacks. Beers served chilled, other drinks prepared to high standard and no scrimping on contents. Delicious fresh food served hot and spiced to order. Great service from all staff, in particular the lovely Dung was gracious, always pleasant, excellent English and enjoyed friendly banter. Premises spotless. Excellent menu selection for food and drinks. If you are staying in hotels nearby, and enjoy delicious food at very economical prices, visit Fresh Restaurant and Cafe, you will not be disappointed.
